concerns.text: T004's `compare_thresholds` exits 1 (full halt) whenever normalized_count < 100, but SC-006 requires halting only the primary regression and proceeding to the sensitivity analysis (FR-011) when total_count >= 100. As written, the task cannot execute the graceful-degradation path the spec mandates; the task's exit-code contract must be re-specified (e.g., a `primary_analysis_halted` flag consumed by T006/T007 while T008 still runs).

T006's verification validates `model_performance.json` against `model_output.schema.yaml`, but that schema has `additionalProperties: false` and REQUIRES `shap_importance` — which is only computed in T009. As ordered (T006 before T009), the task is unexecutable: the artifact cannot pass schema validation at the point its verification runs. Either the schema must be split/staged or T006's verification must be deferred to a post-T009 check.

No task produces any artifact conforming to `output.schema.yaml`, and its `analysis_stage: 'primary' (raw wear_rate)` option contradicts FR-013/T006 (primary model trains only on normalized records). The orphan contract plus its <15-sample `loco_insufficient_samples` semantics (vs FR-006's <30 Linear-Regression-only rule in T007) leave an implementer with contradictory instructions for the same small-class condition.

FR-014 requires that on power < 0.8 the system switch to Linear Regression OR report a `power_insufficiency` warning feeding model selection. T004 only computes/records `power_analysis.json`; T006 trains all three models unconditionally and never consumes the power result. The model-switch/warning branch has no executable task.

SC-001 requires measuring the best model's R² against the baseline Linear Regression R². T006 reports only the single best model's metrics and `model_output.schema.yaml` has no baseline field, so the comparison SC-001 demands is never produced by any task's outputs or verification.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs plan.md:Constitution III / constitution.md
concerns.text: Plan and constitution mandate checksumming raw downloads and recording hashes in `state/projects/...yaml`, plus a pinned `code/requirements.txt`. No task creates `requirements.txt` or implements checksum/state recording — T002 downloads data with no checksum step. These constitution requirements are unexecutable as tasked.

T002's verification greps the codebase to prove 'no synthetic-fallback code path exists (grep for mock/synthetic)', while T004 and T010 verifications explicitly use synthetic test inputs. The grep scope must be narrowed to pipeline code (excluding `code/tests/`) or the two verifications conflict and cannot both pass.
T013 and T014 lack the `[P#]`/`[US#]` tags present on T001–T012; minor consistency gap in the task registry.
